functionEntry.name: remainingSec
functionEntry.documentation: Whole seconds left in the current phase, counting down to 1.

functionEntry.name: advance
functionEntry.documentation:
Feed it the milliseconds since the last call.
Returns true when a new phase has just begun (or the session just ended),
which is the moment the watch should buzz.

functionEntry.name: phaseProgress
functionEntry.documentation: 0.0 at the start of the phase, 1.0 at its end.

functionEntry.name: sessionRemainingSec
functionEntry.documentation: Seconds left in the session, or null when it is open ended.

functionEntry.name: rebuild
functionEntry.documentation:
Re-read the settings and lay out one cycle. Phases set to 0 s are dropped,
so "4-0-6-0" box breathing simply behaves like 4:6 even breathing.

functionEntry.name: level
functionEntry.documentation: How full the lungs are, 0.0 - 1.0. Drives the bar on screen.

functionEntry.name: refresh
functionEntry.documentation: Re-reads every value and updates the sub-labels in place.

functionEntry.name: lengthMin
functionEntry.documentation: 0 means "run until the user stops it".

functionEntry.name: onSettingsChanged
functionEntry.documentation: Fired when the settings are changed from the phone.

functionEntry.name: onBack
functionEntry.documentation: BACK button: end the session and return to the start screen.

functionEntry.name: onSelect
functionEntry.documentation: GPS button: pause / resume, or restart a finished session.

functionEntry.name: onSelect
functionEntry.documentation: GPS button: straight into a session.

functionEntry.name: cuePhase
functionEntry.documentation:
The point of the whole app: a distinct buzz the moment a phase starts.
Inhale is one long pulse, exhale two short ones, a hold a single soft tap.

functionEntry.name: drawLevelBar
functionEntry.documentation:
A column on the left edge that fills as you breathe in and empties as you
breathe out, so the phase is readable from the corner of your eye.
